errors.description: Native credentials were not accepted; the response does not disclose which credential field failed.

The native access or refresh session is expired, revoked, or otherwise unusable. A consumed rotated refresh token is replayable only with the original operation, Idempotency-Key, canonical payload, installation, and an unexpired encrypted response snapshot; every other reuse revokes its token family.
A submission or attachment stage key does not match the canonical clientSubmissionId/clientAttachmentId mapping.

Within the same visible actor and project, the finalized attachment is already reserved or claimed by a different submission, clientAttachmentId, intent, or target tuple. Cross-actor, cross-account, cross-project, or hidden path resources always return NOT_FOUND instead.
Capture IDs, artifact ownership, timestamps, primary system evidence, or Poco enrichment consistency failed validation.
The Accept header does not allow any response media type advertised by this operation, including operation-specific binary or event-stream success representations and structured error fallbacks.
The request Content-Type is not one of the exact request media types advertised by this operation; this includes operation-specific binary bodies, and unknown vendor versions are rejected.
